items.name: analog-gauge
items.title: Analog Gauge
items.description: An analog gauge whose needle swings and settles on its value, with a printed dial and a red zone.

items.name: ascii-text
items.title: ASCII Text
items.description: Text drawn with ASCII characters. A lens around the cursor magnifies, rotates and scrambles them.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: A WebGL background of slowly rippling aurora curtains, in your own colors.

items.name: bento-light
items.title: Bento Light
items.description: A six-cell bento grid with a light that jumps between cells, following the cursor (or on its own), and spills onto its neighbors.

items.name: blur-number
items.title: Blur Number
items.description: A number whose digits roll to the new value with vertical motion blur, one after another.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: A beam of light with a tail, a bright head and a halo that travels around the outline of any content at constant speed.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: A deck of cards you shuffle by dragging the top one: inertia, rotation and a spring back to the bottom. Also works with click and keyboard.

items.name: chime-bell
items.title: Wind Chime
items.description: A glass furin wind chime that sways with the cursor's breeze and rings when touched. It doubles as a notification bell with a counter.

items.name: chrome-text
items.title: Chrome Text
items.description: Liquid chrome letters whose reflection follows the cursor.

items.name: click-burst
items.title: Click Burst
items.description: Fine rays that burst out where you click: they travel outward, detach from their origin and leave a ring and tiny sparks.

items.name: code-rain
items.title: Code Rain
items.description: Columns of real JSX and TypeScript snippets falling across three depth planes, with a glowing head and syntax highlighting.

items.name: confetti-button
items.title: Confetti Button
items.description: A button that fires physical confetti: paper pieces that spin in 3D, fall with air drag and flutter.

items.name: copy-morph
items.title: Copy Morph
items.description: A copy button where the icon outline morphs into a checkmark with a stroke and spring morph. It really copies the text with navigator.clipboard (with a fallback).

items.name: coverflow
items.title: Coverflow
items.description: Album covers in perspective with reflections: the center one faces you and the rest fan out. Arrows, drag with inertia, click and keyboard.

items.name: crosshair
items.title: Crosshair
items.description: A precision crosshair: edge-to-edge lines with a center gap, rulers with tick marks along the edges and live monospace coordinates.

items.name: decipher-text
items.title: Decipher Text
items.description: Text that appears by deciphering itself: random characters settle into place letter by letter.

items.name: dither-wave
items.title: Dither Wave
items.description: A relief of waves drawn with one-bit Bayer ordered dithering. The cursor leaves expanding rings.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A bar of icons that magnify under the cursor, on glass.

items.name: download-button
items.title: Download Button
items.description: A button that narrows into a progress bar, advances at an uneven pace like a real network, and ends in a checkmark. With href, it really downloads the file.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: A slider (role slider, full keyboard support) that stretches like rubber when dragged past its limits and snaps back with a bounce; the track squashes to preserve volume.

items.name: electric-border
items.title: Electric Border
items.description: Arcs of electricity that snake around the border, with local discharges, sparks and a flickering glow.

items.name: fireflies
items.title: Fireflies
items.description: Fireflies that drift at three depths and blink with a warm glow; they curiously approach the cursor and circle it.

items.name: folder-peek
items.title: Folder Peek
items.description: A cardboard folder that opens on hover and lets its documents peek out with a soft bounce.

items.name: galaxy
items.title: Galaxy
items.description: A spiral galaxy of tens of thousands of particles with a glowing core that rotates slowly; the cursor tilts the view.

items.name: glass-blobs
items.title: Glass Blobs
items.description: Blobs of color floating behind a sheet of frosted glass.

items.name: glass-button
items.title: Glass Button
items.description: A liquid-glass button that refracts the background behind it.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: Liquid glass with refraction, a specular edge and a reflection that follows the cursor.

items.name: glass-segmented
items.title: Glass Segmented Control
items.description: A glass segmented control with a lens that slides between options.

items.name: glint-button
items.title: Glint Button
items.description: A dark button with a glint that sweeps across it every so often and on hover, lighting up the fill, the border and the text at once.

items.name: gold-foil-text
items.title: Gold Foil Text
items.description: Gold foil text with relief and a specular glint as you move the cursor.

items.name: goo-cursor
items.title: Goo Cursor
items.description: A translucent jelly cursor with a specular highlight: it drags droplets behind it that stretch into a trail and melt back into it when you stop.

items.name: gooey-tabs
items.title: Gooey Tabs
items.description: Accessible tabs whose selection is a blob of liquid: it stretches toward the new tab, thins at the neck and merges when it arrives.

items.name: grain-mesh
items.title: Grain Mesh
items.description: A mesh gradient that floats and blends, with fine film grain; the cursor pulls on one of the blobs.

items.name: gust
items.title: Gust
items.description: A headline whose letters get swept away by the cursor's wind like leaves, then spring back into place.

items.name: halftone-field
items.title: Halftone Field
items.description: A print-style halftone with two overprinted inks: the dots grow and shrink with a flowing field and with the cursor.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: Press and hold to confirm: a ring fills, the button shakes more and more, and it vibrates on completion. Works with mouse, touch or keyboard.

items.name: holo-foil
items.title: Holo Foil
items.description: A holographic background: an iridescent film, a fine diffraction grating and a sheen that shift with the cursor's angle.

items.name: hologram
items.title: Holo Card
items.description: A card with 3D tilt and an iridescent holographic foil that follows the cursor.

items.name: ink-bloom
items.title: Ink Bloom
items.description: Drops of ink that bloom in dark water with swirls and tendrils, one after another in a cycle. Tap to drop one; move the cursor to stir the water.

items.name: ink-trail
items.title: Ink Trail
items.description: A glossy ink trail that follows the cursor, widens as if bleeding into paper, and frays into strands until it fades away.

items.name: lava-lamp
items.title: Lava Lamp
items.description: A lava lamp with glass and warm light: the wax rises, stretches, merges with other blobs and splits apart. Your cursor warms it.

items.name: lens-cursor
items.title: Lens Cursor
items.description: A glass magnifier that enlarges whatever is underneath it.

items.name: liquid-chrome
items.title: Liquid Chrome
items.description: A chrome surface that ripples and reflects a luminous environment.

items.name: liquid-fill
items.title: Liquid Fill
items.description: A glass flask that fills with liquid.

items.name: live-grid
items.title: Live Grid
items.description: A grid of dots that part and light up around the cursor, on a spring.

items.name: magnet
items.title: Magnet
items.description: Wrap any element and it gets pulled toward the cursor with spring physics.

items.name: magnetic-letters
items.title: Magnetic Letters
items.description: Every letter is pulled toward the cursor by a bouncy spring, tinting and growing as it gets close.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A seamless infinite marquee: the cursor slows it down and nudges it with inertia, rows run in opposite directions, and keyboard focus pauses it.

items.name: mask-reveal
items.title: Mask Reveal
items.description: Staggered lines that slide up from behind a mask, like a product launch intro.

items.name: masonry-reveal
items.title: Masonry Reveal
items.description: A column masonry grid that appears piece by piece as it scrolls into view, with a soft bounce and a flash; hovering a piece zooms it in and shows its title.

items.name: metal-button
items.title: Metal Button
items.description: A polished metal button with a beveled edge and a reflection that follows the cursor.

items.name: metal-card
items.title: Titanium Card
items.description: A brushed-titanium card whose reflection shifts as it tilts.

items.name: metal-knob
items.title: Metal Knob
items.description: A knurled metal knob you turn by dragging.

items.name: morph-loader
items.title: Morph Loader
items.description: A glossy gradient shape that smoothly morphs between circle, square and triangle, spinning and squashing slightly on each change.

items.name: morph-text
items.title: Morph Text
items.description: Words melt into one another with a viscous blur-and-threshold transition and a liquid sheen.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: Numbers that roll digit by digit up to their value, like a mechanical odometer.

items.name: orbit-gallery
items.title: Orbit Gallery
items.description: Cards with generated scenes on a 3D circular carousel: it spins on its own, drags with inertia, and a click brings a card to the front.

items.name: orbit-text
items.title: Orbit Text
items.description: Text on a circle that turns slowly and speeds up, with inertia, when the cursor gets close.

items.name: outline-fill
items.title: Outline Fill
items.description: Outlined text that fills with liquid through a wave that starts where the cursor enters, and drains when it leaves.

items.name: parallax-card
items.title: Parallax Card
items.description: Real 3D layers (sky, stars, planet, ring, dunes, text and shine) that separate at different depths as the card tilts.

items.name: photo-stack
items.title: Photo Stack
items.description: A stack of printed photos that fans out when you hover; a click sends the top one to the back.

items.name: pill-nav
items.title: Pill Nav
items.description: Accessible tabs (tablist, arrow keys, Home and End) with a pill that slides on a spring: the leading edge arrives first and stretches the pill as it crosses.

items.name: pixel-assemble
items.title: Pixel Assemble
items.description: Text assembles itself from a cloud of spring-driven particles; the cursor scatters them and they snap back on their own.

items.name: prism-light
items.title: Prism Light
items.description: A real 3D scene in WebGL2: a glass prism (beveled mesh with fresnel and refraction) on a reflective vinyl floor. A light orb follows your cursor and fires a volumetric beam; the spectrum fans out by Snell's law, one ray per color, and lands on the wall and floor with its caustic. The camera parallaxes with the cursor.

items.name: profile-foil
items.title: Profile Foil
items.description: A profile card with a holographic foil: it tilts in 3D with the cursor and the iridescence shifts with the angle.

items.name: red-thread
items.title: Red Thread
items.description: The red thread of fate: a thread with Verlet physics that follows the cursor, pulls taut against its anchor and swings.

items.name: retro-grid
items.title: Retro Grid
items.description: A perspective grid that scrolls endlessly toward a horizon with a muted sun; the cursor shifts the horizon and holding down speeds it up.

items.name: rgb-glitch-text
items.title: RGB Glitch Text
items.description: Clean text that occasionally breaks into short bursts: split RGB channels and shifted slices.

items.name: ring-cursor
items.title: Ring Cursor
items.description: A ring that follows the cursor with an elastic lag, stretches with speed and, over anything clickable, morphs into its outline like a soft magnet.

items.name: ripple-button
items.title: Ripple Button
items.description: A button whose ripple is born exactly where you click: a luminous wavefront with rings that sweeps out to the farthest corner.

items.name: ripple-pond
items.title: Ripple Pond
items.description: A WebGL water surface: the cursor and raindrops leave ripples that cross, catch the light and warp a grid beneath.

items.name: shimmer-sweep
items.title: Shimmer Sweep
items.description: A satin sheen sweeps across the text like light over aluminum.

items.name: shine-card
items.title: Shine Card
items.description: A satin sheen sweeps across the card as the cursor passes over it.

items.name: silk-flow
items.title: Silk Flow
items.description: A silk fabric that ripples slowly, with an anisotropic thread sheen that shifts with the light and follows the cursor.

items.name: slide-to-confirm
items.title: Slide to Confirm
items.description: A physics-driven handle you drag to the end to confirm; release early and it springs back with a bounce. Accessible as a slider.

items.name: smoke-field
items.title: Smoke Field
items.description: Volumetric smoke with studio lighting that rises endlessly; your cursor parts and swirls it, and the smoke fills the gap back in.

items.name: snowfall
items.title: Snowfall
items.description: Snow in three layers of depth (far, mid and close bokeh) with a wind that blows toward wherever the cursor is.

items.name: spark-trail
items.title: Spark Trail
items.description: The cursor sheds sparks with real physics: they inherit its momentum, fall under gravity, bounce on the floor and cool from white to ember.

items.name: split-flap
items.title: Split-Flap Board
items.description: A board of flaps that flip in 3D, character by character, until the phrase forms, like at a train station.

items.name: spotlight-cards
items.title: Spotlight Cards
items.description: A grid of cards whose borders light up wherever the cursor passes, driven by a single shared light.

items.name: spring-accordion
items.title: Spring Accordion
items.description: An accessible accordion (aria-expanded, regions, arrow keys, Home and End) whose regions open on a real spring: the height bounces as it lands and the content comes in from blurry to sharp.

items.name: spring-tooltip
items.title: Spring Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip (role tooltip) that follows the cursor on a spring and hangs from it like a tag: it tilts with speed and stretches a little as it moves. It also appears on keyboard focus.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Steps with a progress line that fills from one node to the next; the new step lights up as the stroke arrives and the checkmark draws itself on completion.

items.name: sticker-peel
items.title: Sticker Peel
items.description: A glossy die-cut sticker that peels from the corner following the cursor, with curvature, a paper back and a shadow.

items.name: ticket-tear
items.title: Ticket Tear
items.description: A paper ticket with a perforation: drag the stub and it tears from top to bottom, with a fibrous edge and a shadow that grows as it peels away.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: Toast Stack
items.description: Notifications stacked like cards: they fan out on hover or focus, pause while you read them, close on their own and are announced with aria-live.

items.name: topo-lines
items.title: Topo Lines
items.description: A living topographic map: contour lines of a slowly deforming terrain, with labeled index contours; the cursor raises a hill.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types, deletes and retypes phrases with a human rhythm, pauses on punctuation and a blinking cursor.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: Typing Indicator
items.description: A "typing…" bubble with three elastically bouncing dots that, in a loop, turns into the reply with a little spring.

items.name: warp-stars
items.title: Warp Stars
items.description: Stars at warp speed with trails and depth; the cursor steers the vanishing point and holding down triggers the jump.

items.name: weight-wave
items.title: Weight Wave
items.description: The weight of a variable font ripples with the cursor's proximity, letter by letter.

items.name: word-roller
items.title: Word Roller
items.description: A word rolls vertically between options on a spring-loaded drum, and its pill changes width along with it.
